name: Hospitality & Events
tagline: Vetted bartending, wait staff, and hospitality professionals for your next event.
hook_body: Hosting an event should be celebratory, not a stressful marathon of serving drinks and cleaning plates. But hiring reliable temporary staff is historically a gamble. Bouul connects you with ID-verified, experienced hospitality professionals. Whether you need a mixologist for a dinner party or wait staff for a corporate function, browse profiles, check reviews, and handle payments seamlessly.
pains: Agencies charging exorbitant overhead fees for temporary event staff.
Connect directly with the professionals, ensuring fair wages for them and better prices for you.
Staff arriving late or not knowing how to serve professionally.
Platform reviews highlight punctuality, presentation, and skill.
The stress of managing event logistics while trying to enjoy the occasion.
Handle all bookings, communication, and payments through the app so you can focus on your guests.
why_bodies: Skip the agency middlemen and book your preferred staff directly.
Reviewed on punctuality, presentation, and skill so you know exactly who you're hiring.
Handle all logistics from one app — booking to payment.
trust: Reviews focused on punctuality and presentation
faqs: Do the bartenders bring their own equipment?
You can negotiate this via the chat. Many professional mixologists bring their own shakers and tools, while you provide the alcohol.
Can I book staff for a full weekend?
Yes, you can discuss availability and multi-day rates directly with the professional through the app.
